mentions.name: EmailEngine
mentions.description: A service that gives applications structured access to mailboxes: message contents can be fetched with an API request, or it can be configured to send a webhook with structured JSON for every new email, such as the messageNew webhook.
mentions.source_excerpt: You can also get structured data out of mailboxes with my project EmailEngine. You can use an API request to fetch message contents, or you can configure EmailEngine to send a webhook for every new email in a structured JSON, for example, like this: https://emailengine.app/webhooks#messageNew
